mapper.select: select s.subject_id, s.name, s.scope, s.project_id, s.budget_total, s.income_total, s.handler_id, s.status, s.note, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.deleted, u.nick_name as handler_nickname from audit_subject s left join sys_user u on s.handler_id = u.user_id where s.deleted = 0 and s.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') and s.scope = #{scope} and s.status = #{status} and u.nick_name like concat('%', #{handlerName}, '%') and s.create_time >= #{beginTime} and s.create_time <= #{endTime} order by s.subject_id desc

select s.subject_id, s.name, s.scope, s.project_id, s.budget_total, s.income_total, s.handler_id, s.status, s.note, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.deleted, u.nick_name as handler_nickname from audit_subject s left join sys_user u on s.handler_id = u.user_id where s.subject_id = #{subjectId} and s.deleted = 0

mapper.update: update audit_subject set deleted = 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where subject_id = #{subjectId}
update audit_subject set budget_total = budget_total + #{amount}, update_time = now() where subject_id = #{subjectId}
update audit_subject set income_total = income_total + #{amount}, update_time = now() where subject_id = #{subjectId}
mapper.select: select s.subject_id, s.name, s.scope, s.project_id, s.budget_total, s.income_total, s.handler_id, s.status, s.note, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.deleted from audit_subject s where s.deleted = 0 and s.status = 'ACTIVE' order by s.subject_id asc
select ifnull(sum(amount), 0) from audit_fund_flow where subject_id = #{subjectId} and flow_type = 'EXPENSE' and status = 'APPROVED' and deleted = 0

select ifnull(sum(amount), 0) from audit_fund_flow where subject_id = #{subjectId} and flow_type = 'EXPENSE' and status = 'APPROVED' and deleted = 0 and occur_date >= concat(#{yearMonth}, '-01') and occur_date < date_add(concat(#{yearMonth}, '-01'), interval 1 month)
